callGraph.callee:
checks
				.filter((entry): entry is [string, AuthCheck] => entry[1] !== undefined)
				.map

globSync(pattern, { cwd: root })
		.map((match) => resolve(root, match))
		.filter((path) =>
			relative(root, path)
				.split(sep)
				.every((segment) => segment === ".." || !segment.startsWith(".")),
		)
		.sort

packageSources
			.filter(
				(entry): entry is { pkg: PackageSource; scope: Exclude<SourceScope, "temporary"> } =>
					entry.scope !== "temporary",
			)
			.map

entries
		.filter((entry): entry is Model<Api> => typeof entry === "object" && entry !== null && "id" in entry)
		.map

content
							.map((c) =>
								c.type === "image" ? { type: "text" as const, text: "Image reading is disabled." } : c,
							)
							.filter
